_doc: Closed spaces the walk-in reachability audit (check_reachability.py) may report as unreachable rooms but that nobody is meant to enter. Per location group: box = [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] or ring = [cx, cy, r0, r1, z0, z1] (an annulus round a vertical axis) in the location's local frame (metres, as the audit prints 'local (x, y, z)'), matched against the unreachable sheet's centre; reason = why it is not a room. Keep entries tight: anything that is a real room must be fixed in the generator instead.

academy.reason: hollow under the arena stands (ring round the drum centre, tier radii 20 .. 37.3 m): the tiers are shells (tops + risers) standing on the arena floor, closed by the front parapet, the drum wall and the section ends; no door

arena roof and the stepped pyramid over it: the slab inside the drum parapet and the inside of each of the seven steps (closed square ring shells, the floor of each is the top of the step below); no stair, ladder or door leads up there
west end block: top of the 5F ceiling slab under the hip roof (closed roof void; the pavilion stairs end at 5F)
east end block: top of the 5F ceiling slab under the hip roof (closed roof void; the pavilion stairs end at 5F)

inside the obelisk shaft of the north-west corner tower: a closed tapered shell standing on the balcony slab (11 m) - its floor and the tops of the band boxes inside it (the balcony round the shaft is reached from the third-floor glass door)

inside the obelisk shaft of the north-east corner tower: a closed tapered shell standing on the balcony slab (11 m) - its floor and the tops of the band boxes inside it (the balcony round the shaft is reached from the third-floor glass door)

inside the obelisk shaft of the south-west corner tower: a closed tapered shell standing on the balcony slab (11 m) - its floor and the tops of the band boxes inside it (the balcony round the shaft is reached from the third-floor glass door)

inside the obelisk shaft of the south-east corner tower: a closed tapered shell standing on the balcony slab (11 m) - its floor and the tops of the band boxes inside it (the balcony round the shaft is reached from the third-floor glass door)
lobby roof void: top of the lobby ceiling structure (18.4 m) under the roof slab (23.4 m), closed on all sides; no hatch or stair

card shop box inside the lobby: the plenum between the shop's ceiling (5.6 m) and its roof slab (8.5 m), and the roof top itself (8.9 m, behind a decorative balustrade, open only to the 7 m drop into the lobby); no stair leads up
inside the back tiers of the two lecture halls of this wing: the tier blocks are prisms without a bottom standing on the hall floor, so the floor inside them reads as closed pockets
inside the back tiers of the two lecture halls of this wing: the tier blocks are prisms without a bottom standing on the hall floor, so the floor inside them reads as closed pockets

harbor.reason: warehouse: top level (4.5 m) of the two back-to-back pallet racks - beams and decking under the roof, a shelf for goods with no ladder, walled in by the uprights and the stored crates

plaza.reason: inside the closed lintel box of the south entrance gate (a solid beam modelled as a hollow box)
inside the west pillar of the south entrance gate (a closed box standing on its plinth)
inside the east pillar of the south entrance gate (a closed box standing on its plinth)

obelisk_boys.reason: inside the half landing of the foyer's imperial stair: a solid marble block (box without a bottom face) standing on the foyer floor, closed on all sides
inside the portico's gable roof, over the entablature: closed by the roof planes and the pediment, no opening
inside the dome, above the cupola's painted-sky ceiling: closed between that ceiling and the dome shell

obelisk_girls.reason: inside the garden gazebo's dome, on the closed cap over the entablature ring

abandoned.reason: attic over the second-floor ceilings, under the holed roof: no stair or hatch leads up (the hole in the stairwell ceiling is painted damage)
inside the clock tower's spire, above the clockwork room's ceiling (the ladder there ends at a painted hatch)

millbrook.reason: the village house kit is closed by design (Tools/dai/assets/village.py: solid houses, mill and huts with their door leaves modelled shut - there are no interiors), so every walled-in space in the village is the inside of a closed building; the houses are re-settled whenever the river or lanes are re-cut, hence the whole village rather than per-house boxes
